title: "Italian Word Generator"
author: "Robert Beelman"
date: "2026-11-05"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load the csv from quizlet.
```{r}
A1 <- read.csv("~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data-raw/senteri_A1.csv")
B1 <- read.csv("~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data-raw/senteri_B1.csv")
A2 <- read.csv("~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data-raw/senteri_A2.csv")
B2 <- read.csv("~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data-raw/senteri_B2.csv")
A3 <- read.csv("~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data-raw/senteri_A3.csv")
B3 <- read.csv("~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data-raw/senteri_B3.csv")
A4 <- read.csv("~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data-raw/senteri_A4.csv")
```

Bind the above into a complete data file and save.
```{r}
italian_vocab <-
  A1 %>%
  rbind(B1) %>%
  rbind(A2) %>%
  rbind(B2) %>%
  rbind(A3) %>%
  rbind(B3) %>%
  rbind(A4)

save(italian_vocab, file="~/Italian Word Generator/Italian Word Generator/data/italian_vocab_list.rda")
```
